title: CompressGNN: Accelerating Graph Neural Network Training via Hierarchical Compression

problem.claim: GNN training is time-consuming and memory-intensive, limiting practical usage.

gap.claim: Existing GNN training operations contain propagation data redundancy and transformation computation redundancy.

contributions.claim: CompressGNN is a hierarchical-compression framework designed to reduce data and computational redundancy in GNN training.
The framework includes propagation and transformation compression modules.
The propagation module compresses graph structure, while the transformation module compresses similar node features at runtime.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Extensive experiments report an average speedup of 2.32× across multiple datasets and models.

narrative_sequence.summary: GNNs use propagation and transformation operations that can be combined into different architectures.
GNN training is costly in time and memory, limiting practical use.
The work identifies propagation data redundancy and transformation computation redundancy.
CompressGNN applies hierarchical compression through separate propagation and transformation modules.
The authors report an average speedup of 2.32× across multiple datasets and models.

unknowns: The abstract does not identify the datasets, models, baselines, or experimental settings.
The abstract does not report accuracy effects, memory savings, compression overhead, or per-module ablations.
